## Flavor and experience
The name Strawberry Custard Monster points to bright, juicy berry notes with a natural sweet-tart balance, with a bakery-style sweetness with soft vanilla-like warmth. Flavor is personal, so treat the description as a guide rather than a promise: how a profile tastes depends on your device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

## Key features and what they mean for you

- **Clearly labelled strength:** the nicotine strength is shown on the label and on this page, making it easier to compare against what you used before.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Strawberry Custard Monster eJuice suits adult vapers with a refillable pod or tank who want to stay with a flavor they enjoy, and those comparing strengths and bottle sizes before they restock.

## Using and caring for it
Check that your device supports the type of e-liquid you buy: nicotine-salt liquids suit low-power pod systems, while freebase liquids are usually chosen for sub-ohm tanks and higher wattage. Fill slowly, wipe the tip clean, let a fresh coil soak for a few minutes before the first puff, and keep the bottle upright with the cap closed between uses. Store it away from heat and direct sunlight, and keep it away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Strawberry Custard Monster eJuice online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted.
